title: Your identity. Your permission.
intro: Choose whether a specific brand request may use synthetic identity evidence. Consent is not an approval, proof of payment or production authorization.
purpose: Purpose: private identity review for this brand request only.
policy: Synthetic demonstration evidence only. Policy version:
proofHint: Text starting DEMO:, at most 64 KiB. Never upload a real identity document.
agree: I explicitly consent to this purpose and policy version.
refuse: I do not consent. Keep a trackable refusal without evidence.
empty: No consent has been recorded for your account.
withdrawal_pending: Withdrawal requested · downstream fence acknowledgement pending
privacy: Evidence is never public. Only an assigned authorized reviewer may retrieve it. Other brands, sellers and buyers are denied.
scope: Consent is bound to the buyer, brand, request revision, purpose and policy. A changed request needs fresh explicit consent.
withdrawInfo: Withdrawal stops new local checks immediately. The record remains pending until both request and order services confirm the production fence.
signInRequired: Sign in to manage your own private consent.
unavailable: A required service is unavailable. No consent or evidence was saved. Retry when the request service is ready.
error: The request could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
stale_consent: This consent changed. Reload before withdrawing.
request_binding_changed: The buyer, brand or request revision changed. Open the current request.
brand_unavailable: Choose a current platform-onboarded brand with customization support.
consent_already_recorded: Consent is already recorded for this revision. Open the existing record or correct the request first.
evidence_required: Choose a bounded synthetic text file before agreeing.
